propositions: Test exhausts all 232 eligible prose units despite requiring only existential witnesses (at least one eligible unit, at least one changed unit), causing 231 unnecessary Pandoc subprocess calls and 8.829s runtime overhead.

Exact short-circuit evaluation immediately after both existential witnesses are observed reduces runtime from 8.865s to 0.036s (231 subprocess reduction) while preserving pass/fail semantics and failing correctly when no eligible or no changed units exist.
Defect-seeded removal of short-circuit exits causes test to revert from GREEN (0.04s) to RED (232 calls), confirming the fix is necessary and sufficient.
Full-corpus coverage tests using corpus_pass1 independently remain unchanged; fix is test-only and does not affect product Pandoc behavior or dependent consumers.
